title: Divergent bilirubin and concordant direction of ferritin effect in Graves' disease and autoimmune hypothyroidism: a subtype-resolved two-sample Mendelian randomization study
description: R and Python analysis code, configuration, frozen harmonised inputs and expected-result files for a two-sample Mendelian randomization study of autoimmune thyroid disease and sixteen haematological phenotypes.
